1. **[blocking, issue-impact, high]** `rule_header_offsets` recognizes only the literal `[[rules]]` token. Valid TOML also permits whitespace inside an array-table header, such as `[[ rules ]]` or `[[\trules\t]]`; the identity TOML parse accepts these forms, but the scanner at [ruleset_store.rs:213](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/storage/ruleset_store.rs:213) records no block. `sync_namespace_unique_rules` then detects fewer blocks than parsed rules and aborts at [ruleset_store.rs:369](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/storage/ruleset_store.rs:369), after `config set` has already persisted `config.toml`. This leaves the default rule absent from the registry-first `rules.toml`, violating REQ-01/REQ-02. The prior indented-header regression test does not cover whitespace within the brackets. References: `@/charter/D-6`.
